ValidationRule.description: Para perder una oportunidad, los campos Reasons Lost y Description reason for lost deal tienen que estar rellenos
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND (!$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, OR (AND( OR(RecordType.DeveloperName='Business_Opportunity',RecordType.DeveloperName='Draft_Opportunity',RecordType.DeveloperName='Confidential_Opportunity' ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Lost'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(DES_Reasons_Lost__c)), ISBLANK(DES_Description_reason_for_lost_deal__c) ) ))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If you lost the deal, you must complete the key fields Reasons Lost, Description reason.
